name: sled-push
instructions:
1. Load the desired weight onto the sled.
2. Setup in an athletic position with your body inclined into the sled at roughly 45 degrees and your arms extended.
3. Drive the sled forward by extending the leg and hip of one leg.
4. Repeat on the opposite side until you reach the desired number of steps, distance, or time.
